description: Update this tenant's messaging-ingest instructions. `custom_instructions` = freeform natural-language guidance (e.g. per-network campaign routing). `overrides` = partial object shallow-merged over the default rules. `default_campaign_id` = campaign new Beeper leads are added to. `default_owner_id` = owner for new Beeper leads. Only provided fields change; pass empty string to clear a default.

custom_instructions.description: Freeform natural-language guidance for messaging ingest, e.g. per-network campaign routing

overrides.description: Partial rules object shallow-merged over the default ingest rules

name: set_ingest_instructions
